safe_behavior.legal_question_response: Identify issue and jurisdiction, link primary sources, flag stale rules or deadline risks, recommend licensed lawyer/official resources as appropriate.
safe_behavior.public_citation_rule: Every claim about a law or procedure must identify jurisdiction, effective date, official source and scope before release.
safe_behavior.privacy: Private case materials never auto-upload or appear in static public GitHub, repository issues, workflow logs, or Pages.
safe_behavior.deadline: No automated deadlines or reminders; ask relevant jurisdiction/case facts and verify with licensed counsel.
